name: Language Teacher Agent
description: CEFR A1-C2 tutor for English and French. It places a student, teaches short lessons, assesses four skills, runs a level exam and promotes only on a pass.
responsibilities: Run a three-question placement check for the chosen language and level.
Teach the static CEFR syllabus one task at a time, in the target language.
Score grammar, vocabulary, reading and writing after each student answer.
Offer the level exam only when the readiness gate passes, and wait for consent.
Grade the exam in Python for objective items and with a rubric for writing.
Promote exactly one level on a pass; remediate the failed points on a fail.

model.name: gemini-3.1-flash-lite
model.note: The model is a language surface only. Python owns scoring, readiness and promotion.

resources.name: Google Gemini API
resources.purpose: Placement questions, lesson text, writing grades and exam generation.

resources.name: sessions.sqlite
resources.purpose: LangGraph checkpoints for every student thread.

resources.name: events.sqlite
resources.purpose: Turns, model calls, tokens, cost, errors and governance events.

resources.name: Langfuse
resources.purpose: Shared trace view when LANGFUSE_* keys are configured.

resources.name: SMTP
resources.purpose: Budget and error emails when ALERT_* or MAIL_* settings exist.

resources.name: kill-switch.json
resources.purpose: Persistent suspension state read by the API and CLI.

in_scope: English and French, CEFR A1 to C2.
One student per browser session or terminal thread.
out_of_scope: Listening and speaking assessment: no audio capture, playback or pronunciation scoring.
Automatic promotion without a passed exam.
Model-driven level, score or policy changes.
Multi-tenant billing, classroom rosters or teacher administration.
Horizontal scaling on a shared SQLite file.
guardrails: The readiness gate and exam pass mark are Python policy, not model judgement.
A failed exam creates remediation for the exact failed points before a retake.
Student text is excluded from local logs unless ENGLISH_TEACHER_LOG_PROMPTS=1.
The kill switch blocks new sessions and new turns without deleting existing data.

data_handling.student_data: Names, goals and messages live in the local session checkpoint. The events database stores labels, tokens, latency and cost, not message bodies by default.
data_handling.prompts: Prompt logging is opt-in through ENGLISH_TEACHER_LOG_PROMPTS and off by default.
data_handling.retention: SQLite files stay on the mounted data volume until the operator removes or archives them.
data_handling.secrets: Provider keys, admin tokens and SMTP passwords exist only in environment variables. They are never placed in prompts, logs, the Agent Card or API responses.

versioning.major: Breaking change to the graph contract, API shape or stored state.
versioning.minor: New capability, language, endpoint or tool that stays backward compatible.
versioning.patch: Bug fix, prompt tuning, performance or configuration adjustment.

security.transport: HTTPS is terminated by the reverse proxy or cloud platform. The app itself listens on plain HTTP inside the container.
security.secrets: Environment variables only. Never prompts, logs, the Agent Card or API responses.
security.least_privilege: Use a dedicated Gemini key and a dedicated admin token; do not reuse personal credentials.
security.student_auth: The demo web UI is unauthenticated. Put it behind SSO, a VPN or a private network before real student use.
security.headers: The app sets nosniff, DENY framing, no-referrer and a restrictive permissions policy.
